title: Start a Project
intro: Use the form below to share details about your project. This helps determine whether it's a good fit and how to approach scope, timeline, and structure.
responseTime: You'll receive a response within 1–2 business days.

howItWorksSteps.title: Submit your project details
howItWorksSteps.body: Share what you're building, goals, and constraints.

howItWorksSteps.title: Project review
howItWorksSteps.body: I review submissions personally to assess fit, scope, and feasibility.

howItWorksSteps.title: Next steps
howItWorksSteps.body: If aligned, you'll receive a proposal outlining scope, timeline, and investment.

rightColumn.beforeSubmitBody: Please provide as much detail as possible. Clear input helps avoid unnecessary back-and-forth and allows for a more accurate proposal.
rightColumn.privacyBody: Information submitted through this form is used solely to evaluate your project and respond appropriately.

successState.headline: Inquiry received
successState.body: Thank you for sharing your project details. I'll review the information and follow up within 1–2 business days with next steps.

footerNote: Submitting this form does not guarantee acceptance. Projects are selected based on alignment, scope, and availability.
